features.name: Ask Alfred
features.requires: Choose a reply provider and add its API key, or run a local model. Voice also needs a speech service.

features.name: HA tasks, shopping and reminders
features.requires: Select native HA lists. Alfred schedules reminders; the HA iPhone app provides optional push.

features.name: Home, scenes and media
features.requires: Home Assistant with selected devices. Native controls require no MCP plugin.

features.name: Gmail and Google Calendar
features.requires: Optional Google OAuth registration, user consent and connected account. Sending needs additional approval.

features.name: Outlook mail and calendar
features.requires: Optional Microsoft OAuth registration, user consent and connected account. Sending needs additional approval.

features.name: Weather and daylight
features.requires: Set a fallback town or permit approximate iPhone location. Open-Meteo receives the chosen location.

features.name: iPhone notifications
features.requires: HA Companion app with notification permission and a selected phone target.

features.name: Web research and selected news
features.requires: Select public news feeds; live web research additionally requires configured search credentials.

features.name: Routines, plans and personal knowledge
features.requires: Review approved devices and create your own routines. Plans use the configured review preference; memories are explicitly saved.
